style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE grey goose, retiree: big COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, red-yellow party cone, orange feet. Serious face; never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole clerk in MUSTARD-YELLOW suit, always at pit rim; mole's mouth stays shut all 10 s. ONE duckling in green tie, only in last beat.
props: ONE big wooden stamp, mole's; its bottom hidden until 8.7. ONE dark-red booklet. ONE plain white cake with a cherry on a plate, goose's. ONE striped deckchair on the hill.
environment: Sunny wasteland, TURQUOISE sky: narrow bright ORANGE clay pit, brick at rim, clay hill behind mole, green lawn square; deep orange shaft under pit floor.
lighting: Warm key on goose's face all 10s, cyan rim left, magenta rim right; sun floods down pit and shaft. Blue vest vivid in every shot.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.4-7.0 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 7.0 s

timeline.a: Goose ALREADY chest-deep, cake level. Mole slams stamp onto booklet on brick; goose drops half a meter.
timeline.c: camera hurls itself down past the stamp onto the goose, stamp in foreground, goose sinking behind it, close-up

timeline.a: LEFT wing holds cake; RIGHT wing lifts booklet up to mole like at a cashier.
timeline.c: camera dives into the pit, low angle, booklet in foreground

timeline.a: Goose's neck lunges, beak closed, then a polite nod. Mole stamps the booklet, slaps it back onto the brick; goose drops a meter, cake level.
timeline.c: camera rockets back up out of the pit, top-down

timeline.a: Mole flicks clay off the stamp; it rains onto goose's cone and glasses. Beak free.
timeline.c: camera plunges to goose's clay-covered glasses, close-up

timeline.a: Goose in foreground wipes glasses with RIGHT wingtip, LEFT holds cake; behind him on the hill deckchair snaps open.
timeline.c: camera whips round behind goose up to the hill, goose in foreground

timeline.a: Booklet still on brick where mole left it. Goose climbs wall, RIGHT wing scraping, LEFT holds cake; slips; beak free.
timeline.c: camera dives into his beak and glasses, close-up

timeline.a: Mole slams stamp down with both paws from behind his head; pit floor breaks away.
timeline.c: camera flies up and slams down with the stamp

timeline.a: Goose falls feet-down into shaft; wings jerk open, he presses them back. Cake flips cream-down onto plate held level.
timeline.c: camera plunges down the shaft, circling his face, close-up

timeline.a: Mole flips stamp: bottom is a clay-full shovel blade; tosses clay on hill, takes booklet from brick.
timeline.c: camera rockets back up to the shovel, close-up

timeline.a: Mole lays the same booklet at duckling's feet on lawn, raises stamp; square crack opens round his feet.
timeline.c: camera flies up through the soil, looking up at duckling's feet, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, numbers on cake, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, a flat medium shot, dark pit, muted colors, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood
